notes.title: CURSED 2 coming soon in many languages!
notes.notes:

Thanks to the amazing folks in the CURSED SERIES DISCORD SERVER, there are currently many people working on getting CURSED 2 translated to their native language for their respective regions to enjoy. I can only assume we will be doing CURSED 3 once the new content is finished! My only hurdle is figuring out how to make the language options as separate steam depots/branches.

ITALIAN

notes.title: CURSED 2 WIDESCREEN AND EXTRAS MENU FINISHED!
notes.notes:
HEY ALL , I just dropped a big CURSED 2 update. This now includes:
-All assets were extened/moved/redrawn to be in full 16/9
-lots of bug fixes and balancing improvements
-An EXTRAS mode was added to the start menu. You must beat the game to unlock it. Or if you already finished the game in the past and dont want to AGAIN, just type the message 'ibeatthegame' on the start menu. It will be permanently unlocked.

THANK YOU ALL FOR PLAYING!!!!

notes.title: Widescreen Update coming soon!
notes.notes: After many many years Cursed 2 is finally going widescreen! I have to extend all backgrounds and adjust all object placement to accomodate it, but it hasn't proven to be too hard yet. I want all new players this fall to have the best possible experience, along with some minor graphical tweaks and improvements. I'm not sure if the BONUS menu option will roll out with this or not yet, but i will keep workin on it.
